description: register_mail_handlers and register_chat_handlers are public functions whose ClosureHandler type erases CallerCtx and call_id for most methods. Once consumers depend on this API, adding CallerCtx forwarding or any new per-call parameter to the closure type is a breaking change. The current design is intentional for simple backends, but it is underdocumented as a deliberate limitation vs. a temporary one. Before v0.1 the function signature should be either stabilized with a clear statement of what it does not support, or replaced with a builder that makes CallerCtx forwarding opt-in.
title: register_*_handlers closure shape is a frozen public API surface
